day4_start.name: Me
day4_start.text: *...Saturday. My eyes opened on their own, no alarm needed. My heart's already doing its own thing.*

day4_morning_dream.name: Me
day4_morning_dream.text: *Last night's dream was strange. School, hallways, someone's silhouette -- everything was hazy, but the emotions stayed vivid.*

day4_morning_wake.name: Me
day4_morning_wake.text: *Today's finally the day. I tossed and turned for over three hours last night, but the moment I opened my eyes, all sleepiness vanished.*

day4_morning_calendar.name: Me
day4_morning_calendar.text: *I turned on my phone screen. 'Saturday' -- the red letters hit different today.*

day4_morning_excitement.name: Me
day4_morning_excitement.text: *Four days since I transferred. This is the most excited I've ever been for a weekend. My fingertips are tingling.*

day4_morning_guilt.name: Me
day4_morning_guilt.text: *...Wait. I made plans with multiple people but I'm only meeting one. There's a weight sitting in my chest.*

day4_morning_stretch.name: Me
day4_morning_stretch.text: *I kicked off the covers and stretched big. Whatever I'm overthinking, just today -- no regrets.*

day4_morning_mirror.name: Me
day4_morning_mirror.text: *My face in the mirror looks oddly tense. Half nervous, half excited. ...Is it greedy to want to look a little better?*

day4_morning_window.name: Me
day4_morning_window.text: *I pulled back the curtains. Sunlight poured in, blinding me. Today's weather -- approved.*

day4_morning_weather.name: Me
day4_morning_weather.text: *The sky is endlessly clear. Cherry blossom petals drift on the breeze, birdsong layers upon itself. Perfect date weather.*

day4_morning_weather2.name: Me
day4_morning_weather2.text: *The street beyond the window. People on walks, couples ducking into cafes. Soon enough, I'll be part of that scene too.*

day4_morning_kitchen.name: Me
day4_morning_kitchen.text: *I went to the kitchen. Opened the fridge -- slim pickings.*

day4_morning_breakfast_choice.name: Me
day4_morning_breakfast_choice.text: *Plenty of time, but the butterflies are bigger than my appetite.*

day4_morning_breakfast_eat.name: Me
day4_morning_breakfast_eat.text: *Slapped some jam on toast and took a bite. The crunch snapped me awake. Gotta fuel up to function.*

day4_morning_breakfast_skip.name: Me
day4_morning_breakfast_skip.text: *My stomach's staging a protest. Nerves have killed my taste buds. I'll grab something on the way.*

day4_morning_breakfast_done.name: Me
day4_morning_breakfast_done.text: *Alright. Just need to wash up and get ready. Plenty of time.*

day4_morning_groom.name: Me
day4_morning_groom.text: *Washed my face, styled my hair. The mirror's showing me putting in more effort than usual. ...Maybe a touch of cologne?*

day4_morning_nervous.name: Me
day4_morning_nervous.text: *One more check in the mirror. Looking okay. Not bad, actually. ...So why are my hands shaking?*

day4_morning_closet.name: Me
day4_morning_closet.text: *Opened the closet. Besides the uniform, options are limited. What do I wear?*

day4_morning_outfit.name: Me
day4_morning_outfit.text: *First impressions matter. Let's be strategic about this.*

day4_outfit_casual.name: Me
day4_outfit_casual.text: *Comfort is my brand. Going natural beats trying too hard.*

day4_casual_mirror.name: Me
day4_casual_mirror.text: *White shirt, jeans. Clean and low-key. Not bad at all.*

day4_outfit_stylish.name: Me
day4_outfit_stylish.text: *Today's kind of special. This calls for some armor.*

day4_stylish_mirror.name: Me
day4_stylish_mirror.text: *The jacket fits perfectly, slacks line up nicely. I look different from usual -- but not in a bad way.*

day4_morning_outfit_done.name: Me
day4_morning_outfit_done.text: *Outfit decided. Just need to check my phone and head out.*

day4_morning_phone.name: Me
day4_morning_phone.text: *The moment I picked up my phone, a message notification was already waiting.*

day4_msg_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day4_msg_seoyeon.text: "There's a penalty if you're late. Park fountain, 10 o'clock. Don't even think about bailing."

day4_morning_reply_seoyeon.name: Me
day4_morning_reply_seoyeon.text: *A penalty, huh. Classic Seoyeon. I replied 'Not bailing' with a grin on my face.*

day4_msg_seoyeon_2.name: Seoyeon
day4_msg_seoyeon_2.text: "The weather's actually amazing today. Put on sunscreen. If you get sunburned, that's my loss."

day4_reply_seoyeon_2.name: Me
day4_reply_seoyeon_2.text: *'That's my loss' -- my lips curled up on their own. Sounds like Seoyeon's looking forward to this too.*

day4_seoyeon_ready.name: Seoyeon
day4_seoyeon_ready.text: "See you later. Feel free to get your hopes up."

day4_msg_yuna.name: Yuna
day4_msg_yuna.text: "10 o'clock. Cafe by the station. If you're late, I'm leaving."

day4_morning_reply_yuna.name: Me
day4_morning_reply_yuna.text: *Short and blunt. So very Yuna. I sent back 'I won't be late.'*

day4_msg_yuna_2.name: Yuna
day4_msg_yuna_2.text: "...It's nothing. Just didn't feel like drinking coffee alone. ...That's all."

day4_reply_yuna_2.name: Me
day4_reply_yuna_2.text: *That's Yuna's version of 'I want to hang out.' A smile spread across my face.*

day4_msg_dain.name: Dain
day4_msg_dain.text: "HEY HEY HEY!! TODAY'S THE DAY!! GYM ENTRANCE, 11 O'CLOCK!! YOU'RE DEAD IF YOU'RE LATE!!!! I MEAN IT!!!!"

day4_morning_reply_dain.name: Me
day4_morning_reply_dain.text: *An exclamation mark bombardment. Dain's energy is literally exploding off the screen. I typed back a reply.*

day4_msg_dain_2.name: Dain
day4_msg_dain_2.text: "OH RIGHT!! I'll be starving after practice!! Look up restaurants!! MEAT!! I want MEAT!!"

day4_reply_dain_2.name: Me
day4_reply_dain_2.text: *Now she's got me doing restaurant recon. But honestly, eating with Dain -- I'm actually looking forward to it.*

day4_dain_ready.name: Dain
day4_dain_ready.text: "SEE YOU LATER!! GET EXCITED!!! FOR REAL!!!"

day4_msg_nurse.name: Nurse
day4_msg_nurse.text: "If you're free today, how about the art museum downtown? There's an exhibit I've been wanting to see. 11 o'clock, in front of the museum."

day4_morning_reply_nurse.name: Me
day4_morning_reply_nurse.text: *An art museum with the nurse. My heart's racing. I sent back 'I'll definitely be there.'*

day4_msg_nurse_2.name: Nurse
day4_msg_nurse_2.text: "Looking forward to it. Oh, and if you call me 'ma'am' today, there's a fine. Just keep it casual."

day4_reply_nurse_2.name: Me
day4_reply_nurse_2.text: *Don't call her 'ma'am.' Pretty sure my heart just skipped a beat.*

day4_msg_teacher.name: Teacher
day4_msg_teacher.text: "Let's meet at the cafe near school around lunch. There's something I want to talk about. 12 o'clock."

day4_morning_reply_teacher.name: Me
day4_morning_reply_teacher.text: *Meeting Teacher outside of school. Nervous but curious. I replied right away.*

day4_msg_teacher_2.name: Teacher
day4_msg_teacher_2.text: "I'll be in regular clothes, so don't be shocked if you can't recognize me. ...Kidding. You'll probably manage."

day4_reply_teacher_2.name: Me
day4_reply_teacher_2.text: *Teacher cracking jokes. That's a side I've never seen before -- which makes it all the more interesting. Wonder what casual looks like on her.*

day4_teacher_ready.name: Teacher
day4_teacher_ready.text: "Don't be late. I don't like waiting."

day4_morning_loyalty_boost.name: Me
day4_morning_loyalty_boost.text: *The fact that I'm getting ready with just one person on my mind -- it actually steadies me.*

day4_morning_lastcheck.name: Me
day4_morning_lastcheck.text: *One last look in the mirror. ...Not bad. Actually, looking pretty good.*

day4_morning_wallet.name: Me
day4_morning_wallet.text: *Wallet, phone, keys. Pocketed one by one. Better grab a handkerchief too.*

day4_morning_lock.name: Me
day4_morning_lock.text: *Stepped out the front door and locked it. Click -- that sound somehow feels like the start of today.*

day4_morning_outside.name: Me
day4_morning_outside.text: *Warm breeze hit me the moment I stepped outside. Cherry blossom scent brushed past, the streets alive with energy.*

day4_no_date_2.name: Me
day4_no_date_2.text: *It's the weekend and I have zero plans. Four days since transferring -- what have I even been doing?*

day4_no_date_3.name: Me
day4_no_date_3.text: *Can't just rot inside on a day like this.*
choices: Grab snacks from the convenience store and hit the park
Kill time at the neighborhood cafe

day4_no_date_park.name: Me
day4_no_date_park.text: *Bought a rice ball and a drink from the convenience store, sat on a park bench. Lunch for one.*

day4_no_date_park_weather.name: Me
day4_no_date_park_weather.text: *Cherry blossom petals landed on my shoulder. Beautiful scenery, but watching it alone feels a little empty.*

day4_no_date_home.name: Me
day4_no_date_home.text: *Sprawled out on my bed, staring at the ceiling. Is this really how I'm spending today?*

day4_no_date_home_bored.name: Me
day4_no_date_home_bored.text: *Opened social media. Flooded with classmates' weekend photos. Everyone looks like they're having a blast -- am I the only one like this?*

day4_no_date_cafe.name: Me
day4_no_date_cafe.text: *Ducked into the neighborhood cafe and ordered an americano. Grabbed a window seat.*

day4_no_date_cafe_sit.name: Me
day4_no_date_cafe_sit.text: *Sipping coffee while watching couples pass by on the street. The bitterness tastes extra strong today.*

day4_no_date_lonely.name: Me
day4_no_date_lonely.text: *...Spending Saturday alone. But I can't just sit still. Time to walk it off.*

day4_no_date_wander.name: Me
day4_no_date_wander.text: *Wandered aimlessly around the neighborhood until I ended up near the park convenience store. That's when I spotted a familiar figure.*

day4_no_date_meet_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day4_no_date_meet_seoyeon.text: "Huh? You're alone? Talk about perfect timing. I was just on a walk too. Come on, walk with me."

day4_no_date_chat_seoyeon.name: Me
day4_no_date_chat_seoyeon.text: *Seoyeon strolled over with an easy smile. I'd been feeling lonely all day -- is this what fate looks like?*

day4_no_date_chat_yuna.name: Me
day4_no_date_chat_yuna.text: *Yuna pulled out one earbud and looked up at me. Her indifferent expression somehow felt warm.*

day4_no_date_meet_dain.name: Dain
day4_no_date_meet_dain.text: "WAIT?! Running into you HERE!! I just came to grab a drink after practice!! Let's hang out!!"

day4_no_date_chat_dain.name: Me
day4_no_date_chat_dain.text: *Dain came bounding over in her workout clothes. That energy is exactly what I needed.*

day4_no_date_meet_nurse.name: Nurse
day4_no_date_meet_nurse.text: "Oh my, running into you here. I was just out for a little walk too. Want to walk together?"

day4_no_date_chat_nurse.name: Me
day4_no_date_chat_nurse.text: *First time seeing her in casual clothes. Meeting outside school gives off a completely different vibe. My heart's pounding.*

day4_no_date_meet_teacher.name: Teacher
day4_no_date_meet_teacher.text: "...What are you doing here? Teachers get weekends too, you know. Whatever, want to grab some tea?"

day4_no_date_chat_teacher.name: Me
day4_no_date_chat_teacher.text: *Deadpan delivery, but she's the one who spoke first. I caught the slight upturn at the corner of her lips too.*

day4_no_date_after_encounter.name: Me
day4_no_date_after_encounter.text: *We walked together for a while, talking about this and that. The day that started alone transformed in an instant.*

day4_no_date_reflect.name: Me
day4_no_date_reflect.text: *A day that began with no plans at all -- but this one chance encounter made it something special.*

day4_no_date_sunset.name: Me
day4_no_date_sunset.text: *Before I knew it, the sunset was spreading. The sky turning orange. Not a bad day after all.*

day4_no_date_evening.name: Me
day4_no_date_evening.text: *Walking home. Thinking back on today brings a natural smile. I'm curious about tomorrow.*
